name: Zayed International Airport

slots.v: an IATA level 2 (schedules facilitated) airport, with Airport Coordination Limited (ACL) as facilitator

runway.v: two parallel runways, 13R/31L and 13L/31R; the chart gives 4,100 m x 60 m and 4,106 m x 60 m asphalt (it does not pair the lengths with the runway names)

notes: The UAE AIP AD 2 OMAA text PDF was blocked, and older OMAA chart PDFs found by search no longer exist on the GCAA site. The airport's own site (abudhabiairport.ae) was blocked. Slot level comes from the slot coordinator ACL's airport page, which lists capacity declarations up to Summer 2027 (page metadata dated 2016, so content is maintained but the page carries no edit date).
